amendments.reason: HubSpot publishes the owners list in its Crm Owners 2026-09 document, a separate file from the pinned CRM Objects document, and a bundle has one source; the operation is added here exactly as that document declares it (operationId, path and its four query parameters), vendored beside this file as crm-owners-2026-09.json with its digest, and adapters/catalog/tests/hubspot.rs holds this entry equal to that document.

HubSpot publishes the owner read by id in its Crm Owners 2026-09 document, a separate file from the pinned CRM Objects document, and a bundle has one source; the operation is added here exactly as that document declares it (operationId, path, the ownerId path parameter and its two query parameters), vendored beside this file as crm-owners-2026-09.json with its digest, and adapters/catalog/tests/hubspot.rs holds this entry equal to that document.
